title: instrument properties schema
description: Domain-specific fields of an instrument entity, mirroring software/application_properties: shortName and summary carry over unchanged; version becomes firmware and build becomes serialNumber, because those are what identify a physical unit; vendor, model, techniques, components and location are what an apparatus adds over a program.

shortName.description: The short name of the instrument, e.g. jupiter, pdac_com5

vendor.description: Manufacturer of the instrument, e.g. Asylum Research

serialNumber.description: Vendor serial number identifying this particular unit.

firmware.description: Controller or acquisition-software version, the analogue of an application version, e.g. 19.34.88

components.description: Parts of the instrument that matter to a result, e.g. the probe a scan was taken with or the source a film was grown from.

controlSoftware.description: Software driving the instrument, reusing the application entity rather than restating a name and a version.

location.description: Where the instrument is, which for a multi-institution project is part of the provenance.
